title: RAYEN: Imposition of Hard Convex Constraints on Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2307.08336v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Despite the numerous applications of convex constraints in Robotics, enforcing them within learning-based frameworks remains an open challenge. Existing techniques either fail to guarantee satisfaction at all times, or incur prohibitive computational costs. This paper presents RAYEN, a framework for imposing hard convex constraints on the output or latent variables of a neural network. RAYEN guarantees constraint satisfaction during both training and testing, for any input and any network weights. Unlike prior approaches, RAYEN avoids computationally expensive orthogonal projections, soft constraints, conservative approximations of the feasible set, and slow iterative corrections. RAYEN supports any combination of linear, convex quadratic, second-order cone (SOC), and linear matrix inequality (LMI) constraints, with negligible overhead compared to unconstrained networks. translated_title: RAYEN：在神经网络上的硬凸约束施加
translated_abstract: 尽管凸约束在机器人学中有众多应用，但在基于学习的框架中强制执行这些约束仍然是一个悬而未决的挑战。现有技术要么无法保证始终满足约束，要么会产生过高的计算成本。本文提出了RAYEN，这是一个用于在神经网络的输出或潜变量上施加硬凸约束的框架。RAYEN保证在训练和测试期间，对于任意输入和任意网络权重，约束都能得到满足。与先前的方法不同，RAYEN避免了计算代价高昂的正交投影、软约束、可行集的保守近似以及缓慢的迭代修正。RAYEN支持线性、凸二次、二阶锥（SOC）和线性矩阵不等式（LMI）约束的任意组合，与非约束网络相比，其开销可以忽略不计。例如，它可以在1K维变量上施加1K个二次约束（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: RAYEN是一个能够在神经网络输出或潜变量上施加硬凸约束的框架，可在训练和测试阶段对任意输入和权重保证约束满足，支持线性、凸二次、二阶锥和线性矩阵不等式约束的任意组合，且计算开销几乎可以忽略。
en_tdlr: RAYEN is a framework for imposing hard convex constraints on the output or latent variables of neural networks, guaranteeing constraint satisfaction during both training and testing for any input and weights, while supporting any combination of linear, convex quadratic, SOC, and LMI constraints with negligible overhead.
